name: Bloodied Insignia
summary: In Lordaeron's blighted ruins, Bloodied Insignias bear the old Alliance crests of fallen defenders. Many soldiers' families fled south to Stormwind during the Third War.

sections.title: Tokens of the Fallen
sections.body:
Prince Arthas returned with the Scourge and laid waste to Lordaeron. Its great army was overwhelmed, and countless soldiers died defending the capital and the lands around it. Rusted armor and bloodstained brass are all that remain of many who fought.

The old Alliance insignias belonged to those who stood against the undead. Trampled into soil and rubble, the medals recall Lordaeron's last defense.

sections.title: A Messenger for the Exiles
sections.body:
Many survivors fled south across the sea and settled in Stormwind City. Alliance and kinship bind the two human realms, and families in the south still seek news of loved ones lost in the north.

General Marcus Jonathan commands Stormwind's city guard and takes custody of the bloodied insignias. He preserves the defenders' memory and helps their surviving families learn their fate.

faq.answer: They are military medals worn by Lordaeron soldiers who fought and died under the Alliance banner during the Third War.
They are found throughout the Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades, where the kingdom's defenders made their last stand against the Scourge.

faq.q: Why does General Marcus Jonathan want them?
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan commands Stormwind City's guard, where many northern refugees now live. He gathers the medals to honor Lordaeron's fallen and help their living relatives find closure.

faq.q: Why were Lordaeron soldiers wearing Alliance insignias?
faq.answer: The original Alliance was forged in Lordaeron under King Terenas Menethil II to defeat the Old Horde. Lordaeron led the Alliance of Lordaeron through the Second and Third Wars.

faq.q: What happened to the soldiers who wore these medals?
faq.answer: They were killed during the Third War, when Prince Arthas Menethil betrayed the realm, killed his father, and unleashed the Scourge on the capital.

faq.q: Are there still living relatives of these soldiers?
faq.answer: Yes. Thousands of citizens and soldiers fled Lordaeron during the plague and Scourge invasions, and found sanctuary in the Kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: For humans of the Alliance, these badges recall the fall of the greatest human kingdom and connect Stormwind's refugees with their fallen kin in the north.
For the Alliance, returning these medals to General Marcus Jonathan honors the soldiers who died defending their people.
As a paladin, you honor the lost brothers and sisters of the Knights of the Silver Hand by retrieving medals from those who fought beside the order in the capital.
